channel.description: Latest articles from The Christian Post (christianpost.com)

item.title: Beloved 44-year-old pastor dies on New Year's Day after at-home accident
item.description: A beloved West Virginia pastor died on New Year’s Day while working on his pickup truck at home in Putnam County. #Pastor #death #SamPierson

item.title: Bi-vocational pastor, real estate agent reinstated after $5K fine for 'hateful' comments on LGBT-themed coloring book
item.description: After more than three years of legal disputes, a Montana real estate association has reinstated a bi-vocational pastor after disciplining him over comments he made about an LGBT-themed coloring book for children. #LGBT #Pastor #Montana

item.title: World Council of Churches says it's praying, mourning alongside suffering after ski resort fire kills 40, injures 119
item.description: The World Council of Churches has said it is "mourning" with the people of Switzerland and everyone directly affected by the tragic fire that ripped through a bar in Crans-Montana during new year celebrations. #Switzerland #skiresortfire #CransMontana #LeConstellation

item.title: Why do we make New Year’s resolutions? Here's how it started
item.description: The beginning of January is when many people traditionally resolve to start a new, though sometimes challenging, habit and embark on a transformational change in their lives. This is the story of that tradition … #NewYearresolution #NewYear #Liturgicalcalendar

item.title: Mom takes case against school that secretly socially transitioned her daughter to Supreme Court
item.description: A mother in Maine whose parental rights were usurped by school officials who gave her gender-confused daughter a chest binder and referred to her by using a male name and pronouns without her consent is taking her case to the U.S. Supreme Court. #Transgender #Maine #SupremeCourt #Parentalrights #Education

item.title: Trump auctions off Jesus painting for $2.75M during NYE gala at Mar-a-Lago
item.description: President Donald Trump auctioned off a painting of Jesus Christ for $2.75 million during a New Year's Eve bash at Mar-a-Lago in Palm Beach, Florida, on Wednesday. #DonaldTrump #MaraLago #NewYearsEve #VanessaHorabuena #Jesuspainting

item.title: 'Deeply concerning': Street preachers handcuffed, detained outside Dallas arena for violating noise ordinance
item.description: A Texas evangelist who was arrested while preaching the Gospel in downtown Dallas called the arrest “deeply concerning” and urged law enforcement to “respect” the U.S. Constitution. #Texas #Evangelism #Dallas #Police

item.title: Earl McClellan kicks off Passion 2026 warning against conference highs, points students to Christ alone
item.description: Pastor Earl McClellan opened the first night of Passion Conference 2026, urging young Christians to place their expectations not in a conference or an emotional moment but in the transforming power of Jesus alone. #EarlMcClellan #Passion2026 #LouieGiglio

item.title: Top responses to NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani's inaugural address: 'Godless, rancid ideology'
item.description: Democratic New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani drew backlash for his inaugural address, which he delivered from the steps of New York City Hall on Thursday after being sworn in on a Quran by democratic socialist Sen. Bernie Sanders. #ZohranMamdani #NewYorkCity #democraticsocialism #RobertBarron #XiVanFleet

item.title: ISIS New Year's Eve attacks on churches, social gatherings foiled in Syria
item.description: Syria’s Interior Ministry says it thwarted a terror plot by the Islamic State to attack civilian gatherings and churches on New Year’s Eve and bolstered protections for houses of worship. #IslamicState #ISIS #Syria #Christian #Church #Terror
